title: Provision sample-scoped source lookup and publish its storage keys
description: Purpose actual related-audio source lookup without scanning model-wide partition; prerequisites semantic512 native index and publisher accepted. Allowed web/amplify/semantic/resource.ts/resource.test.ts and analysis/apricity_analyze/semantic_publisher.py/test_semantic_publisher.py only. No auth/backend/runtime/browser/dependency or deployment changes. Add dedicated GSI semantic-by-sample partition samplePartition:S, sort semanticId:S, projection ALL for server stored source vectors; leave existing native vector index narrow identity/revision and SearchSchema unchanged. samplePartition is SHA256 of UTF8 compact ordered JSON [embeddingSpace,sampleId] (ensure Unicode parity Python ensure_ascii=False/JS JSON.stringify). Ground PutItem adds samplePartition only at storage boundary; SemanticRecord/identity/revision contracts unchanged. Ground reconciliation Query exact source GSI samplePartition, no FilterExpression or wholeembeddingSpace partition scan; paginate all pages, existing scope/model/sample validation rejects foreign rows before deletion. Upsert idempotent; interrupted run repeat resumes, retire only declared sample, checkpoint after complete success. New policy helper only dynamodb:Query on exact GSIARN for source Lambda, separate from SearchVectors indexARN and canonical Get; publisher Put/Delete tableARN plus Query exactGSIARN. Never guest directvector grant, no stream. Tests REDfirst synth property/GSIprojection/no native index vectorprojection, exactIAMactions/resources, cross-languageUnicodepartition goldenfixture, idempotency/failure/retirement foreignscope and paginated GSIqueries noScan/Filter/wholepartition. Existing sourceauth/modeltests unchanged. Verify tsxresource, Amplifytsc, focused publisher pytest and full semantictests. Root reruns, one task commit then closes; do not claim deployed index/ANN. Block unsupported CDK/DDB property with exactofficialAPI evidence rather than fallbackscan.
right_now_summary: The team is adding a sample-scoped DynamoDB lookup and publishing its storage keys.
